deep_analysis:
48h performance is critical: 33% WR across 51 trades (30 losses, 17 wins), net -0.13 USDT. The vacation guardrail escalation is correct. Three verified patterns explain the bleed:

PATTERN 1 — SHORTS AT MID-RSI ARE COIN FLIPS THAT LOSE. 8 of 12 short losses entered at meta_rsi 48-53 (IO x2 @ 50, MERL @ 49.4, CAKE @ 48.1, ETH @ 51.5, HBAR @ 50.8, PUMP @ 50, ALT @ 53.3). These coins were neutral — not overbought, not dumping. The winning side was either LONG (if the coin held) or waiting for RSI >65 where real shorts live (ETC won at 73.3, LTC at 65.2). We shorted air. The right move was to not short at all, or wait for actual overbought conditions.

PATTERN 2 — LONGS CHASE AT RSI >66 AND DIE. JUP (66.7), ARB (66.7), POL (85.0), SEI (84.2), RESOLV (80.0), USUAL (69.2), BABY (68.8) all lost. These are FOMO entries after the pump is done. Winning longs entered at meta_rsi 56-65 (BANANA 65.2, ICP 63.2, ARB 61.5, FOGO 62.5). The winning side was already long from the 56-65 band and exited into our late entries. We were the exit liquidity.

PATTERN 3 — hard_max_loss = 13/30 losses (43%). These never reached +0.40% for trail to arm. In LOW volatility, trail cannot arm, so every chop entry bleeds to hard_max_loss. The winning side had volatility; we entered when there was none.

Current open trades: BTC LONG SL (81900) sits 0.05% above EMA300 (81861) with NEGATIVE acceleration — any EMA300 touch stops us out, and the 4h regime is SHORT_BIAS. HYPE LONG at meta_rsi 51.3 is the no-man's land profile (worst historical WR band) with SL only 0.16% below current. IOTA is the only sound trade: trail locked above entry at +3.66%, free ride. I would not open BTC or HYPE fresh today.
regime_context: BTC sits 0.45% above EMA300 (82226 vs 81861) after reclaiming it ~9h ago. 15m regime says LONG_BIAS, but 4h says SHORT_BIAS, acceleration is NEGATIVE, velocity SLOW, volume LOW, market phase DECLINING/CALM. This is a mixed chop environment — no clean trend to follow. The 48h data confirms: both LONG (34% WR) and SHORT (32% WR) are losing because neither side has momentum. LOW volatility means trail cannot arm (hard_max_loss pattern). Wyckoff shows ACCUMULATION/UNKNOWN — market is deciding. The 3 LONG positions are directionally aligned with the 15m and continuum (ABOVE EMA300) but exposed to a 4h-trend dump. One BTC break below EMA300 hits all 3 correlated positions simultaneously. Net: we are positioned for a bounce that the higher timeframe doesn't confirm. Not fatal yet, but the correlation risk is real.
